content.text:
**Findings so far**

The interaction features failed. Combining three-month gains in hourly pay and average hours produced a slightly negative, insignificant IC. Pairing a standardized stock rate with a rising flow rate covered only half the sample. Its sign also flipped between low and high index regimes, which points to instability rather than a conditional effect.

The best lead is the six-month change in V03 relative to V02. Its pooled IC was small and positive. However, its HAC t-statistic of 1.99 missed my preregistered threshold of 2.0, so it is formally falsified. Most of its strength sits in low-index periods. After only four attempts, treat it as tentative.
